name: Odometr
positioning: Odometr turns raw vehicle telemetry into audit-ready fleet intelligence for enterprises running thousands of assets across borders.

hero.h1: The telematics backbone for fleets that can't guess
hero.sub: Odometr ingests every signal from your vehicles, sensors, and ELDs, then reconciles it into a single source of truth your operations, compliance, and finance teams all trust.

features.title: Signal reconciliation engine
features.description: We merge GPS, CAN bus, and ELD feeds into one clean timeline per asset — no more three dashboards disagreeing about where a truck was at 2:14 PM.

features.title: Audit-ready compliance logs
features.description: Every HOS entry, DVIR, and IFTA mile is versioned and immutable, so a DOT audit becomes an export, not a fire drill.

features.title: Live cost-per-mile
features.description: Fuel, idle time, and maintenance roll up into a real cost-per-mile figure your CFO can defend line by line.

features.title: Predictive maintenance
features.description: Fault codes and engine-hour trends flag the transmission before it strands a driver on I-80 at midnight.

features.title: Geofence automation
features.description: Yard entries, customer sites, and border crossings trigger workflows and timestamps without a dispatcher touching a thing.

features.title: Open telemetry API
features.description: Stream normalized events straight into your TMS, ERP, or data warehouse with a documented, versioned REST and webhook layer.

testimonials.quote: We consolidated four legacy trackers onto Odometr and cut our monthly IFTA reconciliation from nine days to under two. The reconciliation engine paid for itself in the first quarter.
testimonials.name: Marcus Delgado

testimonials.quote: During our last DOT audit I exported eighteen months of HOS logs in one click. The auditor actually commented on how clean the records were. That never happens.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

testimonials.quote: Cost-per-mile used to be a spreadsheet argument between ops and finance. Now it's a shared number, and we've trimmed idle spend across 2,400 units.
testimonials.name: Devon Aoki
